wire_status: Design obligations on existing owners. Logical field names below describe semantics across boundaries. They are not a released runtime payload or new store.

owners.research_issue: incumbent Macro Issue Desk / qualified operator

value_rules.required: The receiver must validate the field before declaring the named capability usable.
value_rules.nullable: An explicit unknown at source stays unknown. A nullable property cannot confer eligibility, evidence or authority.
value_rules.local_return: Resolved from the existing validated codec or the originating history entry. Do not append extra fields to closed routes.
value_rules.refusal: Preserve the caller's object and provide the reason. A fallback label must identify any change of destination, cohort, source, vintage or selection.
value_rules.precision: Numeric money fields carry currency, scale, sign basis and unit. Preserve exchange dates as local session dates, clock instants with absolute offsets, and source nanoseconds as decimal strings.

listing.guard: Never join two listings by display ticker alone.

observation.guard: A source row without a unique key can be inspected but not promoted to a unique contract or guaranteed replay target. Do not synthesize an observed timestamp from build time.

cohort.guard: Compare two individually validated ReportedGammaSnapshot values bound to the same identity/definition and allowed at the decision cutoff.

node.guard: The coordinate must identify whether the cell is aggregated. Only separately qualified source rows can become pins.

pin.guard: Use optionsContractShortlist.ts for exact accepted shapes, stale policy and duplicate/term checks.

draft.guard: The owner validates options_plan_draft.v1. The user's intended legs/prices are distinct from dated observations and any independently calculated result.

saveIntent.guard: Requires the existing owner's admitted protocol. Reconciliation identity is its operation/idempotency identity. If the API cannot guarantee this, do not expose durable save for this handoff.

replay.guard: No shared cursor conversion across datasets. Each replay reader owns validation, permission, distribution and evidence at cursor.

returnContext.guard: Return metadata is transient, sanitized and same-origin. It does not include credentials, protected data or write intent.

exchanges.accept: Resolve exact root or listing and qualifying dated book. If only root transfers, label the receiving scope explicitly and keep the print as origin.

exchanges.owner: B supplies evidence, C validates pins
exchanges.accept: Select unambiguous actual contracts before admitting legs; distinct contracts share the supported root. Carry immutable/source-limited evidence and preserve user-entered assumptions.

exchanges.owner: source owns return, D owns data/cursor
exchanges.accept: Apply futuresRequest or single-symbol equity grammar; separately verify account, publisher display permission and available window. Exposure replay stays B's presentation over the appropriate archive.
exchanges.decline: invalid_request | access_unverified | plan_required | distribution_withheld | missing_window | gap
exchanges.restore: exact originating view/chart where qualified, otherwise named fallback

exchanges.owner: C previews, incumbent Investigation/alerts owner decides/writes/reads
to: owner object ID and revision after readback
exchanges.accept: Explicit save; arm separately; on reopen compare original evidence with newly acquired observation; assessment creates a new revision.
exchanges.restore: same-owner intent or exact saved revision; no automatic resubmission
